title: Greetings from the Vice President
heading_path: My name is Bongyoung Yoo, and I am the Vice President for International Affairs at the Hanyang University ERICA Campus.
text:
On behalf of everyone here at the ERICA Campus, I would like to extend my warmest welcome to all of our students and visitors. ERICA is an acronym for “Education-Research-Industry-Cluster at Ansan.” Hanyang University and the ERICA Campus are widely recognized as Korea's most successful and active university in terms of industry-academic cooperation, and presently, more than 200 innovative companies are here on campus to work with our faculty and students at Hanyang University.
Moreover, the training programs and research offered at the ERICA Campus have been approved by the Korean government, which has heightened the interest in our high-tech industrial complex among multinational companies choosing to establish a physical presence on campus (Campus Innovation Park Project, 2019~present).
With world class education and hands-on training, ERICA seeks to train and develop leaders ready to work on the global stage, and help them succeed in any career they choose to pursue.
At the core of our efforts is the Office of International Affairs (OIA), a department that organizes, manages, and develops ERICA's global strategies and plans. The OIA is responsible for international cooperation and exchange, international student admissions as well as support services, and seeks to promote the worldwide expansion of Hanyang University and provide students with international experiences.
Living and studying at Hanyang University ERICA can lead to remarkable achievements that last a lifetime.
I hope to see you all at Hanyang University ERICA Campus. We promise to do our best to make your time with us both meaningful and rewarding.
Thank you.
